features.title: Bottleneck Identification
features.description: Identify and highlight bottlenecks in the pipeline execution process.
acceptance_criteria: Bottlenecks are identified based on execution time and resource usage.
Users receive alerts when bottlenecks are detected.

features.title: Cost Reduction Insights
features.description: Provide insights and recommendations for reducing pipeline execution costs.
acceptance_criteria: Cost analysis is based on resource usage and execution time.
Users can view cost trends over time.

features.title: Performance Trend Visualization
features.description: Generate visualizations to display performance trends over time.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizations include line graphs and bar charts.
Users can filter data by date range and pipeline stage.
Trends are updated in real-time with new data.

features.title: Pipeline Stage Optimization Suggestions
features.description: Offer suggestions for optimizing individual pipeline stages.
acceptance_criteria: Suggestions are based on performance metrics and trends.
Users can view detailed reports for each stage.
Optimization impact is estimated and displayed.

features.title: Pipeline Execution Metrics Collection
features.description: Collect and store execution metrics from pipeline processes.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are collected for each pipeline execution.
Data is stored in a centralized database.
Metrics include execution time, resource usage, and error rates.
